scope: Phase5 portable transcription, space-bound embeddings and optional response synthesis

compiledRuntime.scenario: Groq and OpenRouter audio wire parity; scalar/batch vector parity and owned reuse; optional synthesis body/normalization parity

accounting.audio: Reported cost with optional billed seconds or tokens; unavailable is explicit, never fabricated zero
accounting.audioCostInFixture: Scripted response value only; not a real price or measured expense
accounting.audioRetry: One explicitly selected endpoint; no automatic retry/fallback or duration-priced spend certification
accounting.embedding: Verified prompt tokens; unknown usage rejected; no model fallback
accounting.queryReuse: Original usage receipt retained with reused flag; no new inference claimed

productionRouting: Existing JS audio, embeddings, workers and router remain active; legacy synthesis delegates only unchanged pure prompt/normalization
limitations: Isolated endpoint adapters/client/synthesis are not integrated into production workers or database paths.
No automatic audio fallback; duration billing, spend reservation and evaluated retry policy remain open.
Audio container/codec validity must still be verified by ingestion; format metadata alone is insufficient.
OpenRouter STT provider order/only controls are not applied; no chat-style provider pinning claimed.
Current embedding space is a declared manifest, not a new persisted index version/provenance audit; model changes require index evaluation/reindexing.
Fixtures do not certify real transcription accuracy, embedding retrieval quality, synthesis semantics, availability, cost or latency.
Active-run execution bridge, mixed reconciliation/handoff, alternate provider evaluation and full maintained JS migration remain required.
rollback: Remove isolated endpoint/host/synthesis extensions and inline extracted legacy pure helpers; retain previous gateway and durable version fences.
